rows.ARS:
Deep yellow Hybrid Tea.
Registration name: PERsus
Exhibition name: Colossus ™ (hybrid tea, Perry 1998)
rows.Origin:
Bred by Astor Perry (United States, 1998).
Introduced in United States by Certified Nurseries in 1999 as 'Colosus'.
rows.Bloom: Deep yellow. Strong fragrance. 26 to 40 petals. Blooms in flushes throughout the season.
rows.Growing: USDA zone 7b and warmer. Disease susceptibility: very disease resistant. Spring Pruning: Remove old canes and dead or diseased wood and cut back canes that cross. In warmer climates, cut back the remaining canes by about one-third. In colder areas, you'll probably find you'll have to prune a little more than that. Requires spring freeze protection (see glossary - Spring freeze protection) .
rows.Parentage:
Folklore (Hybrid Tea, Kordes, 1977) ×
Golden Gate (hybrid tea, Warriner 1972)
rows.Notes: Tate Rose Nursery says the flowers of this rose are bronze yellow with pink tips...
